findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ibc_inspection_dates" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: mark, code, made, leak, insp, repair, bottle, regime

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_pricing" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product_details · Private data: search_products, get_product_details, get_product_documents, check_product_requirements, create_quote_request · Public sink: compare_products, create_quote_request · Destructive: get_product_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product_details · Private data: search_products, get_product_details, get_product_documents, check_product_requirements, create_quote_request · Public sink: compare_products, create_quote_request · Destructive: get_product_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
